errors.evidence: Thought: To solve this task, I must first determine the set of U.S. presidents’ birthplaces that are cities within the United States. I then need to determine which of these cities is located farthest west and which is farthest east (i.e. having the smallest and largest longitude respective to a – sign, since U.S. cities lie west of the prime meridian). A well‑known fact is that Barack Obama was born in Honolulu, Hawaii, which is in the extreme west (longitude ~ 157°W). On the eastern side among presidential birthplaces, one can note that both John Adams and John Quincy Adams were born in the Massachusetts area – specifically in Quincy, Massachusetts (with longitude roughly –71°W), which is the closest to the prime meridian among those cities. (Many other presidents were born in locations that are more inland or further west than Quincy.) Therefore, the two cities from the extreme ends are Honolulu and Quincy. Finally, the answer must be submitted as an alphabetical, comma‑separated list. Alphabetically, “Honolulu” comes before “Quincy.”
errors.description: The system fabricated the claim that Quincy is the easternmost presidential birthplace, incorrectly concluding that Honolulu and Quincy are the farthest apart. This is a language‑only hallucination.
The final answer deviates from the true answer, as the easternmost presidential birthplace is not Quincy. The system failed to meet the task objective of providing the correct answer.
